text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh~? We still can't run?
Weight training day in and day out... *sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's all this ruckus~? Every single one of ya
is carryin' a face long enough to touch the ground.

Today, the days of continuous rain finally came to a stop.
It had poured so heavily that the drainage couldn't keep up.

Even now, all the staff members are working to maintain the track,
but whether it's runnable remains touch and go...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hello everyone~ Over this way, dear♪

Just then, Super Creek arrived
leading a group of children who had come to watch the training.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oho! The little tykes have arrived!
Guess there's nothin' left to do but get fired up!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, big sisters~.
Aren't you going to run outside~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, dear~.
It's all muddy outside, so we can't run today.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh! We wanna see, we wanna see~~!
Please run, please run~~!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's that? Ya wanna see us run?
Alright, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ah, behold the legendary swift foot! 
Gather 'round and bear witness, one and all~~!

Inari One took off running across the dirt track
which was as muddy as a swamp, but—
(SKIIIIDDD!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ow-ow-ow-ow!
Got too fired up and took a header!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Inari-chan! Are you alright!?
You shouldn't overdo it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Let's just take it nice and easy today... alright?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, no way in hell!
Showin' a half-assed display like that would be tacky as all get-out!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
For us, it might just be another day of practice.
And sure, patience is a virtue in that case.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But those little kids are countin' on us!
What good is our Edo spirit if we let it rot right here!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Inari-chan...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Besides, we've got plenty of frustration bottled up, right?
Ain't that so, folks!?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We do too!
We're gonna fly full throttle--!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, before I knew it...
There's no stopping them now, is there~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um, could you supervise everyone for us?
I'm a little worried with just us watching...
I'd really appreciate some guidance from you~.
choice_data_list: I want them to keep the speed down...
It's fine to run as usual!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's true~.
I feel like full speed would be dangerous too...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hold on now, you can't be serious, you two!
Just when we're all fired up!
choice_data_list: Let's pump up our spirits instead.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Now that's a brilliant idea!
Let's liven things up with some loud shouts then!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come all, it's festival time!
Let's blow these dreary clouds right away!!

Watching the horse girls raise their voices as they ran,
the children got super excited!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, are you sure about that?
If they slip and take a tumble...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
There're times we gotta race on days like this too.
Runnin' as usual is on the tame side, don'tcha think?
choice_data_list: No, running as usual is just fine.
No, keeping it as usual is plenty.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna say all that, I'll take yer word for it~.
Alright then, watch me give 'em a real show!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well whaddya know, this is crazy fast!
Now this is what I'm talkin' about!!

It's easier to build up speed on a heavy dirt track.
The children were absolutely thrilled by her powerful running!
